info.title: Ladoo API
info.description: Ladoo API. `/v1` is tenant-scoped (API key or dashboard session); `/public/v1` serves chat widgets, brands and status without auth. Send `Ladoo-Version` to pick a dated version (default: the one your key was created on) and `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs to retry safely. Responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 adds `Retry-After`. Versions and changes: https://tryladoo.com/docs/developers/changelog

ApiKey.description: Tenant API key (`lsk_…`), scoped. The dashboard instead sends its session cookie plus `X-Ladoo-Workspace`; the person's role maps to the same scopes.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for times in your emails, e.g. America/Chicago

sms_phone.description: Your confirmed mobile number for texts after calls (E.164).

sms_opted_out.description: That number replied STOP, so nothing is texted to it until it replies START.

signup_for.description: Who the sign-up link was for: `agency` or a business type like `plumbing`. Presets onboarding.

texts_available.description: Whether texts after calls can be sent yet. False until Ladoo's texting number is approved; the dashboard shows the setting as coming soon.

caller_texts_available.description: Whether texts to callers (missed-call text back, booking texts) can be turned on. False until carriers approve them; the dashboard shows those switches as coming soon.

staff.description: Ladoo staff (STAFF_EMAILS): the dashboard shows the admin dashboard.

terms.description: The current Terms of Service version, and whether you've agreed to it. The dashboard asks for agreement before anything else when `accepted` is false.

suspended.description: Suspended by Ladoo: it can't be opened until support lifts it

access.description: `inherited`: no membership here, but owner/admin of an agency above it

daily_digest.description: Whether you get this workspace's morning summary email (null with inherited access).

call_texts.description: Texts after this workspace's calls: every call, only urgent and transferred calls, or none (null with inherited access).

call_texts_on_call_only.description: Only while your mobile number is first on call for one of its teams.

call_emails.description: Emails after this workspace's calls, to your account email: every call, only urgent and transferred calls, or none. Unset, it's every call for owners and admins and off for everyone else (null with inherited access).

target.description: What it was done to (an id)

id.description: A person's or key's id; for `calendar`, `crm` or `google`

name.description: The person's name, or the key's name

person.description: The person in People this conversation is linked to

success.description: How the call did against its agent's success criteria (`judgment.outcome` on the call). Null until judged, when not judged, or when the agent has no criteria.

caller_name_corrected.description: The caller spelled a correction to the name on file. Only then does the call's name replace the person's in People and the contact's in the CRM.

channel.description: `phone`, or `web_chat` for the website chat widget

language.description: `es` when the caller spoke Spanish to an English-and-Spanish agent. The transcript is as spoken, with each line's English in `translation` when it was translated; the summary is always in English.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the call ran in: its clock, spoken times and hours conditions. Null for calls before it was recorded.

reached.description: Every outcome the call reached, its outcome (`type`) first: a message taken and then flagged urgent reached both.

hung_up_early.description: Whether the caller hung up right after the greeting: under 20 seconds, before the call moved past its first step. False while the call is in progress.

billable.description: Whether the call counts toward the plan's call minutes. Live calls that were spam, from a blocked caller, or under 10 seconds aren't billed; test calls never are. Null while the call is in progress.

person.description: The person in People this conversation is linked to

steps.description: The steps in `node_trail`, from the workflow version that ran the call, so a debug view can name them. Empty for single-prompt agents and calls without a trail.

crm_sync.description: Whether the call was written to the workspace's CRM. Null when no CRM was connected. `skipped`: spam or a blocked caller, which never reach the CRM.

follow_up.description: Who follows up on this missed call (Settings > General)

text_back.description: The text back to the caller of a missed call. `reason`: why it was skipped or failed. Null when none was queued.

booking_notices.description: What the caller was sent about the appointments this call booked (a confirmation email), including ones skipped and why

translation.description: English translation of `text`, on calls whose `language` is `es`. Absent when the line was already in English or wasn't translated.

entry_index.description: Index of the flagged line in `transcript`

category.description: `incorrect`: contradicts or goes beyond the business's information. `off_script`: skips the call script or breaks an instruction. `unanswered`: a question the knowledge doesn't cover. `tone`: rude or unprofessional wording.

source.description: A quote from the instructions, knowledge or script it's judged against

entry_index.description: The transcript line that broke it (null on calls checked before KAN-430's fix)

status_code.description: A Webhook step's HTTP status; null when no reply came back

status.description: `pending` until the review runs, shortly after the call. `skipped`: not judged, because the workspace's review allowance or the platform's cap said no (`skip_message` says why). `failed`: the review couldn't be completed.

outcome.description: `failed` when any criterion failed, `passed` when all passed, otherwise `unclear`. Null when the agent had no success criteria or the call wasn't judged.

csat.description: Estimated caller satisfaction, 1-5, read from the transcript text (not the voice).

CallJudgment.description: The call judged against its agent's success criteria, with a satisfaction estimate. Null for calls that aren't judged (test calls, chats, spam, no conversation) and calls from before judging.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed; null otherwise

guardrail_breaches.description: The agent's guardrails this call broke, checked in code when it completed. Null when the agent had no guardrails then, or the call is in progress.

minutes.description: Billed call minutes (rounded up), as on the plan's usage meter

after_hours.description: Calls that started outside the business's hours: the booking hours of the calendar the agent that took the call books into, as calls route by them. Calls of agents without set hours aren't counted either way. Null when no agent's hours are known.

hours_known.description: Calls whose agent's hours are known: what `after_hours` is a share of

business_hours.description: The hours `after_hours` is measured against, e.g. `Mon–Fri 9am–5pm, Eastern`. Null when they're unknown or the agents keep different hours.

hung_up_early.description: Calls the caller hung up right after the greeting: under 20 seconds, still on the first step (each call's `hung_up_early`)

items.description: Calls by outcome (null: no outcome yet)

conversations.description: Calls that became a conversation: finished with an outcome that isn't spam, a blocked caller or a client over its minute cap, and the caller didn't hang up early

booking_rate.description: Booked calls over `conversations`. Null with no conversations.

previous.description: The same figures for the period of the same length right before `range`, to compare with

booking.description: Hung up partway through a booking

message.description: Hung up partway through a message

callbacks_waiting.description: Calls the caller hung up partway through a booking or message (each call's `unfinished`): people to call back

urgent.description: Calls the agent noted as urgent (`urgency` high)

flagged.description: Calls with a transcript line the post-call review flagged

calendar_errors.description: Calls where the booking calendar or CRM couldn't be reached: a calendar tool failed with a connection, HTTP or setup error (not a refusal like a taken time)

new.description: People whose first conversation was in the range

returning.description: People in the range who had been in touch before

repeat.description: People who called more than once in the range

unknown.description: Calls not linked to a person

callers.description: Callers, by the person each call is linked to

busiest.description: Calls by weekday and hour they started in `time_zone`; empty hours left out

daily.description: Calls per day in `time_zone`, every day of the range

judged.description: Calls judged against their agent's success criteria

csat_average.description: Average estimated caller satisfaction (1-5). Null with none estimated.

judging.description: Calls reviewed after they ended (each call's `judgment`)

reasons.description: The most common call reasons, most first

calls.description: Calls in the range that ran this version

ended.description: Calls whose last step was this one

steps.description: Every step of the version in workflow order: breadth-first from the start, then steps the caller can jump to anytime, then any others

workflow.description: Where calls went in the agent's live workflow version. Only with `agent_id`; null when the agent has no live version.

versions.description: Only with `agent_id`: each workflow version of the agent that ran calls in the range or was published in it, oldest first, with how its calls went

phone.description: E.164. Spaces, dashes and parentheses are ignored; a bare 10-digit number is read as a US/Canada number.

block_anonymous.description: Hang up on calls with no caller ID (withheld, anonymous or private numbers) before the agent answers, like a blocked number.

level.description: `red`: calls or bookings are failing now. `amber`: fix soon.

message.example: Google Calendar (sam@example.com) was disconnected, so bookings can't be checked.

path.description: The dashboard page that fixes it

workspace.description: The client workspace it's in; null for this workspace

name_edited.description: The team typed or picked the name

crm_url.description: A link to the contact in your CRM. Currently always null.

names.description: The two names compared, for a similar or heard name

strong.description: A shared phone, email or CRM contact

matches.description: People who look like this one, strongest first

failing_since.description: When deliveries started failing, with no success since. After 3 days of failing the endpoint is paused and the workspace's owners are emailed.

auto_disabled_at.description: When Ladoo paused the endpoint for failing. Cleared when it's resumed.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: After a rotation, deliveries are signed with the new and the old secret until then.

secret.description: Signing secret for the Ladoo-Signature header. Shown only once.

test.description: Sent with Send test event, with sample data

response_body.description: The start of the receiver's last response body (2 KB)

next_attempt_at.description: When it's tried again; null once delivered or failed

monthly_price_cents.description: What this number costs each month; null for numbers Ladoo manages

past_due_since.description: When the plan's payment failed; null unless it's past due

grace_ends_at.description: Past due: when live calls pause unless the payment goes through

blocked.description: Why calls, chats, number purchases and test minutes are paused right now, or null

model_spend.description: AI model spend this period, in USD: live calls (included, never capped), automatic reviews of live calls (`call_review`), judging test results (`judge`) and test simulations (`simulation`), each capped by the plan; holds for runs in progress count as used

BookingCalendars.description: `all`: every connected calendar set to take bookings, at the time of the call. `selected`: only these (an empty list: the agent doesn't book).

account.description: The connected account: the CRM account's id, the Google or Microsoft account's email, or a calendar link's name.

name.description: The calendar's name when it was chosen, for notices if it goes away.

state.description: `partial`: a chosen calendar went away and the agent books into the rest. `not_used`: its booking tools are off.

calendars.description: Where it books right now, e.g. `CRM`.

notice.description: What the owner should know or do, in plain words; null when fine.

team_id.description: Team to alert about urgent calls. Stored now; alert delivery is not built yet.

AgentPreCallWebhook.description: The URL Ladoo POSTs to when a call rings, before the agent answers. The signing secret is shown only when it's set or rotated.

max_call_seconds.description: Ends the call after this many seconds; at most 3600.

disclosure.default: I'm an AI assistant, and calls may be recorded, transcribed and handled by our service providers.
disclosure.description: Said on every phone call right after the greeting's first sentence (Terms §4.2). It must say the call may be recorded and transcribed and that service providers handle it. It should also say the caller is talking to an AI assistant and can ask for a person or leave a message; leaving those out is allowed, but some places require them.

languages.description: `en`: English only. `en_es`: English and Spanish. The greeting stays in English and invites Spanish speakers to speak Spanish; a caller who does gets the rest of the call in Spanish. Summaries stay in English.

base_variables.description: The variables as the editor loaded them. When set, only the keys changed or removed relative to these apply, so settings saved meanwhile (from Build with AI, say) are kept. Unset replaces the variables with `defaults.variables`.

base_languages.description: The languages as the editor loaded them. When set and `defaults.languages` is the same, the languages saved meanwhile (Spanish turned on by Build with AI, say) are kept.

allOf.description: Which calendars the agent books into. Unset keeps the current choice. A newly chosen calendar must be connected to this workspace (422 `calendar_not_connected`).

criteria.description: Plain rules for a good call, e.g. "Booked a visit or took a full message". Up to 10, each up to 200 characters; blanks and repeats are dropped. After each live call a reviewer marks each one pass, fail or unclear.

secret.description: The signing secret for the `Ladoo-Signature` header, when this request created or rotated it. Shown only here; null otherwise.

url.description: An https URL on a public host (port 443). Null turns the webhook off and deletes its secret.

name.description: What the model calls it: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

description.description: When to use it and what it returns, for the model.

url.description: https on a public host. May use `{{args.x}}`, `{{fields.x}}` and `{{variables.x}}` after the host; values are URL-encoded.

headers.description: Values are secret: shown as `••••••••` once saved. Send that back to keep one.

body.description: A JSON template with `{{args.x}}` placeholders inside strings. Empty sends the arguments as the JSON body (GET sends them as the query string).

say_while_waiting.description: Said to the caller while the request runs, e.g. "Let me check that."

response_fields.description: The dot paths in the JSON reply the agent may read. Nothing else reaches it.

origin.description: `owner`: written by hand. `call`: made from a real call. `assist`: Build with AI.

edited_at.description: When the owner last changed the test by hand. An edited suggestion is kept when tests are suggested again.

AgentTestCallTime.description: The local time (in the agent's time zone) the simulated call happens at, e.g. to test an after-hours caller. Null: the next weekday at 10:00.

outcomes.description: The call passes when it ends with any of these outcomes

text.description: A plain rule a judge checks, e.g. 'Offers a Tuesday time'

goal.description: Simulated tests: what the caller wants, e.g. 'Book a cleaning next Tuesday'

persona.description: Simulated tests: who the caller is and how they talk, e.g. 'In a hurry, terse'

caller_turns.description: Replay tests: what the caller said, in order

caller_turns.description: Replay tests: what the caller said, in order

runner_online.description: False: the test runner hasn't checked in, so queued tests are waiting

unknown.description: Tests without a scored result on both sides

not_run.description: Of `unknown`, tests scored on live with no score on the new version (an error, a timeout or a skip). `block` refuses a publish while this is above 0.

AgentTestComparison.description: The candidate against live, when the run tested a candidate

reused.description: A current live result from an earlier run, not run again for this check

max_call_seconds.description: Ends the call after this many seconds; at most 3600.

disclosure.default: I'm an AI assistant, and calls may be recorded, transcribed and handled by our service providers.

languages.description: `en`: English only. `en_es`: English and Spanish. The greeting stays in English and invites Spanish speakers to speak Spanish; a caller who does gets the rest of the call in Spanish. Summaries stay in English.

publish_check.description: What Save & publish does when tests got worse: `warn` (default) shows it and lets the owner publish; `block` refuses until they pass; `off` doesn't run them

GuardrailCheck.description: `phrases`: the agent never says any of these (whole words, any case). `detail`: the agent never says this, like a private number (numbers match by their digits). `judge`: a judge reads each test call and decides; live calls aren't judged yet.

rule.description: The rule in the owner's words

id.description: Public: it goes in the embed snippet

agent.description: The agent that answers. Changing it keeps the same snippet. While `deleted`, the widget takes no chats until it's given another agent.

allowed_origins.description: Websites allowed to show the widget, like https://example.com. `https://*.example.com` covers its subdomains.

conversations.description: Chats through it this billing period

title.description: Header title. Defaults to the agent's name

greeting.description: First message. Defaults to the agent's greeting

launcher_label.description: Text beside the launcher button. Null shows the icon only

allowed_origins.description: Pasted URLs are trimmed to their origin
Pasted URLs are trimmed to their origin

PendingGreetings.description: Greeting changes that go live on the agent when this workflow is published

greetings.description: Greeting changes to apply to the agent on publish. Omit to keep the draft's; null clears them.

graph.description: A valid graph, or null when nothing changed

allOf.description: Greetings the assistant changed (only the changed keys), or null

questions.description: What the assistant needs answered before it can finish; usually empty

test_causes.description: For a request with `tests`: the tests grouped by cause. Only `workflow` causes change the graph; `agent` and `setup` ones change nothing (`setup` names the step to take), and `unknown` ones the assistant couldn't explain.

ai_credits.description: Build with AI messages left after this one

id.description: Stable id within the answer, e.g. `hours`

label.description: Short topic for the answered summary, e.g. Hours

kind.description: `choice`: pick an option or type another; `text`: free text; `hours`: opening hours

setting.description: Business setting the answer is saved to, e.g. `business_hours`

current_hours.description: The calendar's hours now, to put back on Undo

BookingHoursProposal.description: Booking hours to offer the owner: they stated hours and the booking calendar is still on its default hours. Nothing is changed until they apply it with PATCH /integrations/calendars/{id}. Null otherwise.

graph.description: The workflow on the canvas now

answers.description: Answers to the assistant's last questions

fixes.description: Notes the editor flagged that the owner asked Build with AI to fix (Fix with AI): each note's code, its step and the note's text

answer.description: The owner's answer; null when they skipped it

setting.description: Business setting the answer is saved to

hidden.description: A build from a script; leave it out of later messages

base_graph.description: The graph the run started from

answers.description: The answers this run was sent with, or null

prompt.description: The owner's message, as the chat shows it

messages.description: The conversation to send; required unless script_id is set

script_id.description: Build the flow from this script

graph.description: The workflow on the canvas now

answers.description: Answers to the last run's questions. Ones with a `setting` are saved to the agent's business settings.

fixes.description: Notes the editor flagged that the owner asked Build with AI to fix (Fix with AI): each note's code, its step and the note's text

tests.description: Agent tests that failed, got worse or were unclear, that the owner asked Build with AI to fix (Fix with AI on test results): got worse first, then failed, then unclear

questions.description: What the assistant needs answered before it can finish; usually empty

ai_credits.description: Build with AI messages left after this one

AgentAssistDraft.description: The whole draft after the change, or null when nothing changed

allOf.description: The agent as it is in the editor now

answers.description: Answers to the assistant's last questions

created_by.description: The person who published it; null for an API key

live.description: The version the agent's calls use now

workflow.description: What the version runs: its graph (or single prompt), fields, tools and calendar choice. Webhook header values are masked.

changes.description: The keys that changed on a changed step (prompt text among them)

steps.description: Steps added, removed or changed, in `to`'s order

flow.description: Changes to where the call starts and to the edges every step has

settings.description: Changes to the version's fields, tools and calendar choice

text_keys.description: Step keys holding text the agent says or follows, to compare word by word

outputs.description: When ok: the declared outputs the code returned

ignored.description: When ok: returned keys that aren't declared outputs

error.description: When not ok: what went wrong

fields.description: Details collected so far, by key

variables.description: Business settings, plus values earlier code steps returned

progress.description: What the build has done so far

description.description: The business, in the owner's words

status.description: empty: no sources; processing: a source is queued or indexing; needs_attention: a source failed or has pages that failed; else ready

KnowledgeSourceConfig.description: What the source ingests. Lists leave out `text` and `pairs`.

max_pages.description: Defaults to, and is capped at, the plan's pages per website

question.description: What the caller asked or said, as the agent should recognize it

answer.description: What the agent should say or know when it comes up

data.description: Attached to the agent, in order

workflow_knowledge_bases.description: Not attached, but named by a knowledge step of the agent's published workflow; calls use them too

token_estimate.description: Across every knowledge base calls use: attached and workflow ones

inline.description: True when the agent's knowledge (attached and workflow) is small enough to be kept in context, as calls do

content.description: The script's text: Markdown headings, one line per line, `[say exactly]` marks

verbatim.description: Say this line exactly as written

content.description: Up to 40,000 characters (422 `script_too_long`). `#` headings start sections; start a line with `[say exactly]` to have it said word for word.

sections.description: Replaces the sections; the content is rebuilt from them

script_ids.description: In the order the agent follows them; replaces the set

graph.description: The workflow on the canvas now

recognize_callers.description: Whether the agent gets a returning caller's name and recent calls from People. People fills in either way.

caller_booking_changes.description: Whether callers can change or cancel their bookings on a call (on by default). Off, the agent takes a message for the team instead.

text_back.description: Whether a caller who hung up before anything was done gets a text back (off by default). Sent from Ladoo's texting number, 8 AM to 8 PM in the call's time zone.

text_back_message.description: The owner's own words for that text; null sends the default

follow_up_user_id.description: The member put on each missed call to follow up, and emailed about it

viewer.description: The caller's own access (scopes only, for API keys)

Brand.description: The agency's white-label, for a client workspace of a branded agency

overage_per_minute_centicents.description: Price per minute past the included minutes, in hundredths of a cent

billing.description: What the agency bills this client through its own Stripe. Left out without `billing:read`.

at_cap.description: At the cap, `continue` keeps answering and counts the overage; `forward` sends live calls to `fallback_number` without answering

rate_per_minute_centicents.description: The agency plan's per-minute rate, in hundredths of a cent, used for `estimated_cost_cents`

status.description: Mail is sent from it only when `verified`

sign_in_url.description: A sign-in page with the agency's brand

applies.description: Whether clients see the brand now: it needs a name and the Agency plan

prefix.description: Public part of the key, safe to show

api_version.description: The API version (`Ladoo-Version`) the key's requests use unless they send one

scopes.description: What the key may do; each must be a scope you have yourself

preset.description: Instead of `scopes`: `read_only`, `calls_people` or `full`, cut down to the scopes you have. With neither, the key gets everything you have.

allowed_ips.description: IPs or CIDR ranges the key may be used from; empty for anywhere

Null for a calendar with none (team and round-robin calendars use each member's hours); null overall until first read. Change them in the CRM.

booking_hours_at.description: When `booking_hours` were last read from the CRM.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline for opportunities. Null: calls create no opportunities.

booked_stage_id.description: Stage an opportunity moves to when the call books. Null: don't move it.

outcome_tags.description: Also tag contacts by outcome, such as `ladoo-booked`.

A person with a phone number is found by it like someone who called: a later call from that number joins their history, and the agent knows their name when the workspace recognizes returning callers. delete.description: Its subscription on the agency's Stripe ends at the end of the current period.

get.summary: Active API keys (the secret part is never shown again)

post.summary: Create an API key
post.description: The new key can do no more than the caller can do here. The full key is in this response only.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key; requests using it fail from now on
Give back a test session's minutes when the agent never joined
delete.description: A session holds its minutes from when it's created. If the agent never picks up, this gives them back right away instead of when the token expires, and the room can't start a call afterwards. Once the agent has joined it answers 409 `test_session_started`: the minutes free up when that call ends.

post.summary: Start a browser test session (voice or text) with an agent
post.description: Mints a short-lived LiveKit token for a fresh room with the agent dispatched. The session is recorded as a call with kind=test and counts against the plan's test minutes; it ends on its own when they run out. The agent doesn't need a phone number.

get.summary: List TTS voices available to agents
get.description: Voices in the ElevenLabs account, sorted by name, limited to those usable with the agent TTS model (professional clones must be trained for it). `search` matches name, description and labels. Upstream responses are cached for a few minutes.

get.summary: Get one voice

post.summary: Hear a short phrase in a voice
post.description: Synthesizes up to 200 characters with the agent TTS model, e.g. to check how a pronunciation sounds before publishing. Identical requests are cached for a few minutes. Each workspace (with an agency's clients) can play 50 a day on the Free plan and 500 on paid plans (429 `voice_preview_limit`).

post.summary: Connect a calendar link
post.description: Books without signing in to Google or Microsoft. `url` is the calendar's private iCal address (https:// or webcal://); it is fetched to check it, then stored sealed, and read for busy times. Bookings are kept in Ladoo: subscribe to `feed` to see them. It is added beside the workspace's other calendars; `connection_id` replaces that calendar link's address instead, keeping its name, settings and subscribe address. 409 `calendar_already_connected`: that address is already connected.

post.summary: Cancel an appointment
post.description: Removes the appointment from every calendar Ladoo wrote it to (only the event Ladoo created), and keeps it as cancelled. One calendar failing doesn't stop the others: `events` says what happened in each, and calling this again retries the ones that failed. Calling it on a finished cancel changes nothing. Your CRM may notify the contact, depending on its settings.
